 The Director Sales (Automotive Electronics) will be responsible for driving strategic business growth, customer acquisition, revenue, and profitability across the Automotive Electronics business. 
 The ideal candidate will have a strong track record of selling automotive electronics systems and sub-systems directly to Automotive OEMs and Tier-1 suppliers , with demonstrated experience in products such as Electronic Control Units (ECUs), automotive electronics clusters, instrument clusters, display systems, infotainment systems, telematics, communication/connectivity systems, ADAS electronics, body electronics, and other vehicle electronic systems .

 The role requires close collaboration with Engineering, Program Management, Manufacturing, Quality, Supply Chain, Finance, and other internal functions to ensure successful customer acquisition and sustainable business growth. 
 The position requires extensive interaction with Automotive OEMs and Tier-1 customers and involves frequent travel across India and internationally, as required. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 1. Business Development & Sales Drive order intake, revenue, profitability, and market share growth for the Automotive Electronics business. Develop and execute strategic sales and business development plans aligned with organizational objectives. Identify and acquire new Automotive OEM and Tier-1 customers . Automotive Electronics Product Sales Drive sales of automotive electronics systems and sub-systems to OEMs and Tier-1 customers. Demonstrate strong understanding of products such as: Electronic Control Units (ECUs) Instrument Clusters / Digital Clusters Display Systems Infotainment Systems Telematics and Connectivity Systems Communication Systems ADAS Electronics Body Control Electronics Gateway and Vehicle Networking Systems Battery Management Systems (BMS) Power Electronics EV Electronics Understand customer technology roadmaps and identify opportunities to position the company's products, engineering capabilities, manufacturing capabilities, and system integration solutions. Work closely with technical teams to develop customer-specific solutions and value propositions. 3. Strategic Account Management Establish and maintain CXO and senior-management relationships with Automotive OEMs and Tier-1 customers. Develop long-term strategic partnerships with key accounts. Understand customer product, platform, technology, sourcing, and localization strategies. Develop strategic account plans and identify opportunities for cross-selling and up-selling. Increase wallet share within existing accounts. Proactively manage customer expectations and ensure high levels of customer satisfaction. Act as the senior commercial interface between the organization and strategic customers. 4. Market Development Monitor Automotive Electronics market trends, OEM sourcing strategies, technology developments, and competitive activity. Identify emerging opportunities in: Electric Vehicles (EV) ADAS Connected Vehicles Infotainment Digital Cockpit Displays Telematics Vehicle Connectivity Power Electronics Battery Management Systems Body Electronics Vehicle Networking Develop market-entry and market-penetration strategies for new customers and product segments. Build business cases for new markets, products, customers, and geographies. Maintain strong industry intelligence regarding OEM platforms, upcoming vehicle programs, sourcing decisions, and technology roadmaps. 5. Commercial Management Lead pricing strategy, commercial proposals, negotiations, and business closure. Own commercial discussions with customer procurement and sourcing teams. Ensure business proposals meet targeted revenue and profitability objectives. Evaluate commercial risks and develop appropriate mitigation strategies. Support contract negotiations and commercial agreements in collaboration with Legal, Finance, and senior management. Ensure appropriate commercial governance throughout the sales cycle. 6. Sales Strategy, Forecasting & Business Planning Develop annual and long-term sales and business development strategies. Prepare revenue, order booking, pipeline, and customer forecasts. Develop customer account plans, opportunity plans, and business capture plans. Monitor sales funnel performance and conversion ratios. Present periodic sales reviews, pipeline updates, business forecasts, and strategic account updates to executive leadership. Ensure high forecasting accuracy and achievement of annual business targets. 7. Cross-Functional Leadership Work closely with Engineering, Product Development, Program Management, Manufacturing, Quality, Supply Chain, Finance, and Operations teams. Coordinate internal teams during RFQ, product development, prototype, validation, NPI, production ramp-up, and mass production phases. Ensure customer commitments relating to quality, cost, delivery, technology, and commercial objectives are effectively managed. Support escalation management and resolution of critical customer issues. 8. Customer & Industry Engagement Represent the organization at Automotive OEM meetings, technology forums, industry conferences, trade shows, and customer events. Build strong relationships within the Automotive Electronics ecosystem. Track industry developments and communicate relevant market intelligence internally. Develop relationships across OEM Purchasing, Sourcing, Engineering, R&D, Program Management, and senior leadership teams. 9. CRM & Sales Excellence Maintain accurate customer, opportunity, quotation, pipeline, and forecast information in the CRM system. Ensure disciplined CRM usage and timely reporting. Establish effective sales processes, opportunity qualification, pipeline reviews, and sales governance. Track sales performance metrics and continuously improve sales effectiveness.
